strings.forge.title: HEARTFORGE · MANUAL FABRICATION
strings.forge.description: The Mechromancer must build every early machine personally. Fabrication takes time, emits noise, and disables the pistol. Automation is a later evolution.
strings.forge.evolve: 9  EVOLVE HEARTFORGE TIER · manual, loud, exposed
strings.release.title.continue_hint: Continue the latest verified transactional save.
strings.release.title.new_hint: Begin again with one damaged Heartforge and one indispensable machine.
strings.release.post_victory: The sanctuary remains playable after the first victory.
strings.endgame.severance.name: Severance
strings.endgame.severance.ending: The signal collapses. Organisms remain in the streets, but the intelligence coordinating them is gone. The machines inherit a wounded, survivable town.
strings.endgame.containment.name: Containment
strings.endgame.containment.ending: The lattice closes around the signal. The hostile ecology becomes local, animal, and finite. The Heartforge survives as the centre of a machine sanctuary rather than a conquering empire.
strings.objective.endgame.active.title: HOLD THE HEARTFORGE
strings.objective.endgame.active.detail: {0}. Routine machines and outposts continue acting autonomously; intervene only where the final response breaks through.
strings.objective.endgame.active.prompt: HOLD THE HEARTFORGE · INTERVENE ONLY IF THE FINAL RESPONSE BREAKS THROUGH
strings.hud.sanctuary.critical: SANCTUARY CRITICAL · THE WARM LIGHT IS FAILING
strings.notification.survival_profile: SURVIVAL PROFILE · THE TOWN IS LISTENING
strings.story.record.endgame_severance.name: The Severed Root
strings.story.record.endgame_severance.descripti: The root signal went quiet by force. The town remained wounded and dangerous, but the machine sanctuary no longer had to answer a buried intelligence calling through every nest.
strings.story.record.endgame_containment.name: The Caged Root
strings.story.record.endgame_containment.descrip: The root signal was enclosed instead of erased. The ecology remained alive and local, a dangerous neighbour whose limits the machines had finally learned to hold.
strings.world.condition.storm_front.name: Storm Front
strings.world.condition.storm_front.description: A hard coastal front keeps the town slick, loud and close.
strings.world.condition.mist_lull.name: Mist Lull
strings.world.condition.mist_lull.description: The rain thins, but wet fog turns every distant light into a warning.
strings.world.condition.cold_break.name: Cold Break
strings.world.condition.cold_break.description: A brief clear break reveals more of the ruined town before the weather closes again.
strings.world.condition.signal_bloom.name: Signal Bloom
strings.world.condition.signal_bloom.description: A charged organic resonance stains the fog cyan and makes every machine light feel watched.
strings.world.condition.ashfall_drift.name: Ashfall Drift
strings.world.condition.ashfall_drift.descriptio: A dry ash front drifts through the broken district; orange practicals burn through a dirty sky.
strings.objective.opening.salvage.title: RECOVER YOUR FIRST SCRAP
strings.objective.opening.salvage.detail: Follow the amber ground lights to the highlighted municipal wreck ({0}). Hold {1} to dismantle it; the pistol goes offline and the noise attracts organisms.
strings.objective.opening.scrapper.title: BUILD YOUR FIRST SCRAPPER
strings.objective.opening.scrapper.detail: Return along the cyan route to the Heartforge ({0}). Press {1} at the assembly plate and choose Build Scrapper. Fabrication is loud and leaves you dependent on the Bulwark.
strings.objective.opening.autonomy.title: LET THE SCRAPPER TAKE OVER
strings.objective.opening.autonomy.detail: Press 2 to set Salvage focus. The machines choose a wreck, form a protected group, travel there physically, recover Scrap, and return without individual orders.
strings.objective.opening.expedition.title: PREPARE THE NORTH RUINS GROUP
strings.objective.opening.expedition.detail: Return to the forge and manually fabricate one Warden and one Pathfinder. The Warden protects vulnerable machines; the Pathfinder keeps the expedition coherent.
strings.prompt.opening.route: FOLLOW THE AMBER ROUTE · STAY WITHIN THE BULWARK'S PROTECTION
strings.prompt.opening.salvage: HOLD {0} · DISMANTLE THE HIGHLIGHTED WRECK · PISTOL OFFLINE · NOISE ATTRACTS ORGANISMS
strings.prompt.opening.forge: PRESS {0} · OPEN THE HEARTFORGE · BUILD SCRAPPER
strings.prompt.opening.return: FOLLOW THE CYAN ROUTE BACK TO THE HEARTFORGE
strings.prompt.opening.escort: PRESS {0} · BUILD THE MISSING WARDEN OR PATHFINDER

strings.operation.dynamic.route_recovery.name: Reopen the {0} route
strings.operation.dynamic.route_recovery.descrip: Repeated organic blockages have made the remembered route through {0} unreliable. Send a protected engineering group to reopen the corridor and teach the society which street can carry the next formation.
strings.operation.dynamic.machine_recovery.name: Recover {0}
strings.operation.dynamic.machine_recovery.descr: {0} went dark in {1}. Authorize a protected retrieval group to reach the casualty beacon, restore the disabled frame, and carry it back before the ecology buries the signal.

strings.adaptive.proposal.none: No adaptive Heartforge proposal is waiting.
strings.adaptive.proposal.reason.damage: The Heartforge architect found repeated perimeter damage at {0}% integrity and proposes one structural response.
strings.adaptive.proposal.reason.pressure: The Heartforge architect detected organic pressure at {0}% around the district and proposes a quieter defensive principle.
strings.adaptive.proposal.detail: Machines will handle geometry, escorts, construction and reconstruction. Choose one principle; this proposal is a rare run-level commitment.
strings.adaptive.state.authorized: The machine society is travelling to the Heartforge perimeter to build the selected response.
strings.adaptive.state.complete: {0} is online. Routine geometry remains machine-managed.
strings.adaptation.anchored_shell.description: The machines sink a redundant brace lattice into the Heartforge shell where repeated frontal impacts are breaking through.
strings.adaptation.anchored_shell.problem: Observed damage is concentrating on the Heartforge perimeter.
strings.adaptation.anchored_shell.tradeoff: The anchored shell absorbs the most direct damage, but its heavy service frame makes ordinary machine activity louder.
strings.adaptation.sacrificial_hollow.descriptio: The machines hollow the outer ring into a replaceable buffer so the living core sits behind a deliberately expendable shell.
strings.adaptation.sacrificial_hollow.problem: The Heartforge needs a buffer that can fail without exposing the core immediately.
strings.adaptation.sacrificial_hollow.tradeoff: The hollow reduces incoming damage, but its exposed service cavities draw more organic attention during construction and repair.
strings.adaptation.quiet_core.description: The machines wrap the cognition core in damped shrouds that lower the ordinary signal reaching the surrounding ecology.
strings.adaptation.quiet_core.problem: Organic pressure is concentrating around the Heartforge's ordinary machine signature.
strings.adaptation.quiet_core.tradeoff: The quiet core attracts less routine attention, but it leaves less physical shell between a determined assault and the core.
strings.operation.west_grid_survey.name: Survey the West Grid
strings.operation.west_grid_survey.description: Send a Pathfinder-led group through the flooded industrial corridor, map stable streets, and recover the surviving grid archive.
strings.operation.east_tenement_roofline.name: Trace the East Roofline
strings.operation.east_tenement_roofline.descrip: A light Pathfinder group crosses exposed roofs and suspended walkways to map a safer eastern approach and mark a viable observation court.
strings.operation.tram_graveyard_recovery.name: Recover the Tram Servo Bank
strings.operation.tram_graveyard_recovery.descri: Engineers cut a matched servo bank from derailed municipal trams while Wardens hold the maintenance pits.
strings.operation.glasshouse_spore_harvest.name: Harvest the Glasshouse Mycelium
strings.operation.glasshouse_spore_harvest.descr: A protected work group enters the shattered glasshouse at dusk and extracts a luminous mycelial lattice without spreading its spores home.
strings.operation.flood_market_recovery.name: Recover the Vital Membrane
strings.operation.flood_market_recovery.descript: Cross the flooded market, cut a stabilising membrane from a living municipal generator, and carry it home intact.
strings.operation.riverworks_pump_recovery.name: Restart the Riverworks Pump
strings.operation.riverworks_pump_recovery.descr: Engineers restart one municipal flood pump, draining a hunting basin and creating a calmer southern route for future machine groups.
strings.operation.cathedral_brood_suppression.de: A heavily escorted formation must reach the brood chamber, hold position under sustained attack, and remove its resonant gland.
strings.operation.observatory_migration_map.name: Calibrate the Observatory Array
strings.operation.observatory_migration_map.desc: Pathfinders and Engineers restore the ridge optics long enough to chart migration corridors across the whole town.
strings.operation.buried_lab_excavation.name: Excavate the Genome Prism
strings.operation.buried_lab_excavation.descript: Engineers breach the buried laboratories while escorts protect the excavation and Scrappers carry the prism back to the surface.
strings.operation.root_cistern_mapping.name: Map the Root Cistern
strings.operation.root_cistern_mapping.descripti: A late autonomous expedition traces the ecological signalling network. A Signal Relay must hold the machine path through the root pressure long enough to map a final protocol route.
strings.operation.north_archive_sublevel.name: Recover the Archive Sublevel
strings.operation.north_archive_sublevel.descrip: A compact autonomous group descends beneath the first archive route to recover sealed civic records and reopen a sheltered service approach.
strings.operation.east_residential_rescue.name: Rescue the Residential Beacon
strings.operation.east_residential_rescue.descri: Machines cross the exposed roof bridge to recover a municipal warning beacon before fast pack organisms collapse the remaining residential arc.
strings.operation.west_transformer_repair.name: Repair the West Transformer
strings.operation.west_transformer_repair.descri: Engineers restart a second transformer bank while escorts hold the canal service road, reducing the industrial signal that draws route predators.
strings.operation.root_signal_purge.name: Purge the Root Signal Ledge
strings.operation.root_signal_purge.description: A relay-capable formation severs one exposed signal branch above the final basin, lowering the response waiting for the chosen endgame protocol.
strings.operation.apex_lure.name: Lure the Cistern Apex
strings.operation.apex_lure.description: Draw the largest predator away from the final route. Success reduces the ecological response during the chosen endgame protocol.
strings.operation.post_victory_archive.name: Recover the Town Archive
strings.operation.post_victory_archive.descripti: After first victory, a small autonomous group recovers civil records and machine names from the archive for the continuing sanctuary.
strings.command.adaptive.empty_summary: No structural proposal is waiting. Machines continue ordinary defence without opening a maintenance task.
strings.command.adaptive.empty_status: Status: the architect will speak only when a real structural decision exists.
strings.command.adaptive.cost: Machine construction: {0} seconds · Cost: {1} Scrap · geometry and repair remain delegated
strings.command.evolution.empty_summary: No strategic decision is required at this moment. The machines will continue routine work without opening another management task.
strings.command.evolution.empty_detail: Continue the current objective. Recover Scrap, fabricate the required machine class, complete a physical expedition, or meet the next Heartforge prerequisite. The interface will become actionable only when a real choice exists.
strings.command.evolution.locked_status: Status: locked by world progress — not by a hidden menu selection.
strings.command.evolution.summary: Choose one consequential technology. Routine execution remains delegated to the machines. Scrap {0} · Cognition Cores {1} · Active doctrine: {2}
strings.command.outposts.summary: Choose a discovered fixed site and strategic role. Machines choose builders, escorts, route, construction, repair, hauling, and rebuilding.
strings.command.outposts.locked_detail: Autonomous outposts unlock at Heartforge Tier 2. Recover a Cognition Core and authorize the next Heartforge evolution before asking machines to establish a fixed support site.
strings.command.outposts.locked_status: Status: locked by Heartforge progression · no site placement or worker management is available.
strings.command.outposts.no_sites_detail: Pathfinders must discover viable foundations through physical excursions. Outposts cannot be placed freely and do not claim territory.
strings.command.outposts.no_sites_status: Status: no site decision exists yet. {0}
strings.command.outposts.cost: Construction requires Scrap, a free Engineer, a Warden escort, and route capacity. Destroyed posts rebuild automatically when those conditions return.
strings.command.role.defence: Automatically attacks nearby organisms and creates a proxy defensive screen away from the Heartforge.
strings.command.role.scout: Extends early warning and reports organic contacts without creating a permanent management task.
strings.command.role.repair: Repairs friendly machines passing through its service radius during remote operations.
strings.command.role.recovery: Recovers local Scrap into forward storage; protected haulers physically carry it to the Heartforge.
strings.command.recap.status: A short strategic readout for returning to a persistent world.
strings.command.recap.close_hint: Press ESC, P, L or V to close.
strings.command.endgame.status: The final crisis is player-triggered and causal. No recurring wave schedule exists.
strings.command.archive.status:
{0} story thread{1} · {2} record{3} recovered from physical discoveries.
Threads assemble from what the machines actually found; this history is optional and never creates another maintenance task.
strings.command.operations.status: Every group travels through the same persistent world and delivers rewards only after returning.
strings.command.archive.empty_requirements: Explore and complete real discoveries to recover the town's remaining records.
strings.command.empty_requirements: Continue the current strategic objective. The screen becomes actionable only when a real choice exists.
strings.command.archive.close_hint: Press L or ESC to close.

strings.command.operations.requirements: Cost: {0} Scrap · Team: {1} · Work exposure: {2} s · Threat {3}
strings.command.archive.empty_detail: No town records have been recovered yet. The first record is preserved at the Heartforge; later records emerge from physical regional discoveries and the post-victory archive.
strings.command.endgame.empty_detail: Recover the required biological components, map the Root Cistern, evolve the Heartforge to tier 5, and authorize an endgame technology. Until then, no final decision is being hidden.
strings.command.operations.empty_detail: Complete the current Heartforge, outpost, or technology prerequisite. Routine salvage, repair, rebuilding, and replacement continue without opening another management task.
